title: apply's lead-passage row is refused when the lead does not answer: no route miss, the lead line holds most of the question's key words
goal: ql_apply.from_lead skips a rules finding whose observed route is miss, and a lead-passage row is tried only when the lead line holds most of the question's key words, since an _self eval row passes on anchor-in-doc plus phrase-in-pack (_tools/rag.py:290-299) and so a lead that does not answer still passes the gates; ql_apply.anchor_phrases takes its candidates only from the text the pack prints of the lead line, not the whole line rules_one reads, so a correct lead whose rarest phrase sits past the clip yields a row that passes; a no-fix record names the row's eval failure (text or anchor), not only 'eval fails' and an unchanged mean pack; one planted failure pins a lead that does not answer staying no-fix, and kb/_self/querylog.md (Apply, Rules findings) stops saying a wrong lead fails the eval.

run:
import sys,tempfile,pathlib,types
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import ql_apply as a
LEAD="The zqxwidget plomkinator frobnicator quuxifies every plomkin on commit."
def go(q,obs):
    t=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
    g=types.SimpleNamespace(fresh=lambda:None,measure=lambda:{"n":1,"passed":1,"failed":[],"chars":{"EV-x":100},"offkb_good":0},rules_eval=lambda:t/"e.csv",rules_aliases=lambda:t/"a.csv",rules_pack=lambda x:{"text":"coverage: weak\n\n## kb/_self/w.md\n- kb/_self/w.md:7 "+LEAD+"\n"},rule_line=lambda r:("w.md",LEAD),token_counts=lambda:{},anchored=lambda row:row[5] in LEAD,alias_terms=lambda rules=True:{})
    r,human=a.rules_one({"id":"F-1","kind":"rules","observed":obs},{"question":q},g,{"chars":{"EV-x":100},"offkb_good":0})
    return (r or {}).get("state"),human
weak={"verdict":"weak"}
got={"answers":go("which plomkinator frobnicator quuxifies every plomkin on commit",weak),"off-topic lead":go("how are laptops enrolled into autopilot at provisioning",weak),"route miss":go("which plomkinator frobnicator quuxifies every plomkin on commit",{"verdict":"weak","route":"miss"})}
print(got)
sys.exit(0 if got["answers"]==("applied",False) and got["off-topic lead"][0]=="no-fix" and got["route miss"]==(None,True) else 1)

import sys,tempfile,pathlib,types,csv
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import ql_apply as a
LEAD="The zqxwidget plomkinator frobnicator quuxifies every plomkin on commit."
CLIP="The zqxwidget plomkinator frobnicator quuxifies every"
Q="which zqxwidget plomkinator frobnicator quuxifies every"
COUNTS={w.lower():50 for w in CLIP.split()}
def go(measure):
    t=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
    g=types.SimpleNamespace(fresh=lambda:None,measure=lambda:measure,rules_eval=lambda:t/"e.csv",rules_aliases=lambda:t/"a.csv",rules_pack=lambda x:{"text":"coverage: weak\n\n## kb/_self/w.md\n- kb/_self/w.md:7 "+CLIP+"\n"},rule_line=lambda r:("w.md",LEAD),token_counts=lambda:COUNTS,anchored=lambda row:row[5] in LEAD,alias_terms=lambda rules=True:{})
    r,_=a.rules_one({"id":"F-1","kind":"rules","observed":{"verdict":"weak"}},{"question":Q},g,{"chars":{"EV-x":100},"offkb_good":0})
    rows=list(csv.reader(open(t/"e.csv",encoding="utf-8")))[1:] if (t/"e.csv").is_file() else []
    return r,rows
ok_m={"n":1,"passed":1,"failed":[],"chars":{"EV-x":100},"offkb_good":0}
r,rows=go(ok_m)
phrase=rows[0][5] if rows else None
bad_m={"n":2,"passed":1,"failed":["SQ-x"],"why":{"SQ-x":["text"]},"chars":{"EV-x":100},"offkb_good":0}
r2,_=go(bad_m)
gate=(r2 or {}).get("observed",{}).get("gate",[])
print("anchor phrase:",repr(phrase),"| failed eval record:",gate)
sys.exit(0 if phrase and phrase in CLIP and any("text" in g for g in gate) else 1)

import sys
t=open("kb/_self/querylog.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
bad="a lead that does not answer the question fails the eval" in t
print("querylog.md still says a wrong lead fails the eval:",bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import re,sys
t=open("_tools/test_redact.py",encoding="utf-8").read()
n=len(re.findall(r"^def test_\w*lead\w*",t,re.M))
print("test_redact.py tests of the lead passage:",n)
sys.exit(0 if n>=2 else 1)
